PagerBot: :rotating_light: [Pager] SERVING-RUNTIME PROD — high 5xx rate detected. Alert 4321. 5m error rate 12% (baseline 0.3%). Link: https://alerts.redwood.com/alerts/4321
Maya Chen: I'm taking this. Paging runtime + infra. @Ash @InfraOnCall can you confirm scope?
Devin Patel: I'm awake, jumping in. Are we seeing across all regions or isolated to us-east-1?
PagerBot: Error signature: "kv-cache unavailable" -> 503 from runtime nodes; affected endpoints: /v1/generate, /v1/chat
Ash Kaur: seeing repeated connection reset and socket timeouts on runtime-v2-{pod}. suspect node-level IO issues. grabbing logs now.
Ash Kaur: ```
$ kubectl logs runtime-v2-3f8 --since=10m
E/serve: kv-cache: dial tcp 10.0.42.12:1234: connect: connection refused
E/serve: upstream 503
``` 
InfraOnCall: I'm looking at host telemetry — several GPU hosts in us-east-1 showing high iowait and a couple reboots around 03:12 UTC. Possibly noisy host causing K8s evictions. I'm evacuating pods away from f-node-17 and running health checks. Runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/runbooks/infra-noisy-host
Maya Chen: okay, so ownership: runtime to handle service-level fallback and routing; infra to heal hosts. @SecurityOnCall any immediate concerns?
SecurityOnCall: no signs of lateral movement or exfil; auth logs look normal so far. keep me posted if tokens/keys show anomalies.
Samir Ortiz: customer impact: Support reported increased timeouts from enterprise customers A & B (tickets #1892, #1893). CS notified. ETA for mitigation?
Ash Kaur: mitigation plan — enable fallback model-compact for new sessions and reduce batch_size from 64->16 to avoid KV pressure. Command to flip routing (internal API):
```
POST https://api.redwood.internal/config/routing
{ "rule": "runtime-v2 -> model-compact", "percent": 10 }
```
Devin Patel: I'll apply 10% canary to fallback now and watch error rate. Applying in 2 mins.
Devin Patel: applied canary. Monitoring dashboards: https://grafana.redwood.com/d/serving/errors?orgId=1
PagerBot: alert update: error rate dropping to 3.2% in canary region :chart_with_downwards_trend:
Maya Chen: handoff / shift note — Devin, do you need relief later? I'm primary from now until 08:00 UTC. Ash will be secondary. There's a coverage gap 06:00-07:00 currently; we need a volunteer to cover that hour for infra escalations.
Devin Patel: I can't extend past 04:00 UTC due to deploy freeze. Sorry. @Joanne Li and @InfraOnCall any chance to cover 06-07?
Joanne Li: I can cover 06:00-07:00 for infra escalations. I'll be on-call then. :+1:
Maya Chen: thanks Jo. Samir — you cover customer comms for the window, loop Joanne for technical updates.
Samir Ortiz: will do. prepping short status update for affected customers now.
Maya Chen: note for handoff runbook: https://confluence.redwood.com/runbooks/oncall-handoff — follow checklist (primary -> secondary, incident summary, outstanding actions, watch period).
Devin Patel: quickdiag — no config drift found; root cause looks like noisy host + large batch leading to kv connection exhaustion. Postmortem owners: Ash (runtime) + InfraOnCall. I'll attach timeline.
InfraOnCall: hosts stabilized after cordon/drain; migrating remaining pods. Reboots look like crashloop due to kernel bug; filing infra ticket #INF-872.
PagerBot: :white_check_mark: Alert 4321 status: mitigated. 5m error rate now 0.6% (within SLO). Will create postmortem and tag owners. 
Maya Chen: great work team. I'll run the handoff checklist and open the follow-up doc. If anything spikes, page primary. :eyes:
SupportOnCall: thumbs for comms. I'll close customer-facing incident note once postmortem URL is available.
PagerBot: incident closed -> creating postmortem draft at https://confluence.redwood.com/pages/INC-4321
